<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
    <title>污鸦的状态栏（改自路西法酱）</title>
    
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+SC:wght@300;400;500;600;700&family=Noto+Serif+SC:wght@500;600;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
    <style>

        :root {

            --c: #d2aaf0;
            --c-glow: rgba(210, 170, 240, 0.55);
            --c-soft: rgba(210, 170, 240, 0.12);

--txt: #f0f2f8;
            --txt2: #c8cdd8;
            --dim: #6b7288;

--shell-bg: linear-gradient(160deg, rgba(18, 8, 28, 0.92) 0%, rgba(28, 12, 40, 0.88) 40%, rgba(12, 4, 20, 0.94) 100%);
            --shell-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            --shell-shadow: 0 24px 72px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 0 1px rgba(210, 170, 240, 0.12), inset 0 0 48px rgba(180, 120, 220, 0.07), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);

--toolbar-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);

--card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.045);
            --card-bg-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            --card-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
            --card-border-hover: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
            --card-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            --card-shadow-hover: 0 12px 36px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.48), 0 0 0 1px rgba(210, 170, 240, 0.14), 0 0 40px rgba(210, 170, 240, 0.07);

--block-bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
            --block-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            --block-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);

--panel-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            --panel-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);

--tile-bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.42);

--btn-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 45%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.16) 100%);
            --btn-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            --btn-text: var(--c);
            --btn-on-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07) 50%, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08) 100%);
            --btn-on-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.26);

--modal-bg: linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(18, 16, 32, 0.95), rgba(12, 10, 22, 0.98));
            --modal-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
            --overlay-bg: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88);

--empty-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            --empty-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            --empty-text: #788098;

--transition-smooth: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);

--radius-xs: 6px;
            --radius-sm: 8px;
            --radius-md: 12px;
            --radius-lg: 16px;
            --radius-xl: 20px;
            --radius-2xl: 24px;
        }

::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 3px; height: 3px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: transparent; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12); border-radius: 6px; }
        ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22); }

        * {
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }

        /* [perf] 长聊天里每条消息一份状态栏；离屏时跳过样式/布局/绘制。
           注意：content-visibility 会打断内部 position:fixed，改后卡片内的固定定位一律按 absolute 处理。 */
        html, body {
            content-visibility: visible;
        }
        .w {
            contain-intrinsic-size: auto 600px;
        }

        body {
            font-family: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans SC", sans-serif;
            color: var(--txt);
            background: transparent;
            overflow-x: hidden;
            padding: 0;
            -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
            -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
        }

        button, input {
            font: inherit;
        }

        /* ===== [perf] 默认冻结无限动画 =====
           原脚本让每条消息各自常驻跑 glowDrift 8s / shellBreathe 6s / particleFloat ×30 /
           edgeShimmer 4s 等无限动画 —— 一条消息一台永久动画放映机。
           注意 .glow-overlay / .stars-layer / .sheen-overlay 与 .all-stack 是兄弟节点，
           所以这里以 .w（状态栏根容器）为根选择器，不能用 .all-stack。
           外观基本不变（这些动画本来就极慢且低对比）；想恢复原样：
           给状态栏根容器（.w）加 class="sb-perf-high"。 */
        .w:not(.sb-perf-high) .particle,
        .w:not(.sb-perf-high) .sheen-overlay,
        .w:not(.sb-perf-high) .glow-overlay::before,
        .w:not(.sb-perf-high) .glow-overlay::after {
            animation: none !important;
        }
        .w:not(.sb-perf-high) .sheen-overlay {
            opacity: 0.45;
        }
        .w.sb-perf-high .particle,
        .w.sb-perf-high .sheen-overlay,
        .w.sb-perf-high .glow-overlay::before,
        .w.sb-perf-high .glow-overlay::after {
            animation: revert !important;
        }
        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
            .w, .w * {
                animation: none !important;
                transition: none !important;
            }
        }

.noise-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 1;
            opacity: 0.08;
            background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='n'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.75' numOctaves='5' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23n)' opacity='1'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
            background-repeat: repeat;
            background-size: 128px 128px;
            /* [perf] 原为 mix-blend-mode: multiply —— 强制该覆盖层与卡片成组合成。 */
        }

.scanlines-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 1;
            opacity: 0.07;
            background: repeating-linear-gradient(
                0deg,
                transparent,
                transparent 2px,
                rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 2px,
                rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55) 3px
            );
        }

.glow-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: inherit;
        }

        .glow-overlay::before {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            top: -40%;
            left: -20%;
            width: 140%;
            height: 180%;
            background: radial-gradient(
                ellipse at 50% 50%,
                rgba(180, 100, 220, 0.10) 0%,
                rgba(120, 40, 180, 0.04) 35%,
                transparent 70%
            );
            animation: glowDrift 8s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes glowDrift {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); opacity: 0.6; }
            25% { transform: translate(3%, -2%) scale(1.05); opacity: 0.8; }
            50% { transform: translate(-2%, 3%) scale(1.02); opacity: 0.5; }
            75% { transform: translate(-1%, -1%) scale(1.07); opacity: 0.7; }
        }

        .glow-overlay::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            border-radius: inherit;
            animation: shellBreathe 6s ease-in-out infinite;
        }

        @keyframes shellBreathe {
            0%, 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(180, 120, 220, 0.07); }
            50% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 58px rgba(200, 140, 240, 0.12); }
        }

.stars-layer {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 2;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: inherit;
        }

        .particle {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: radial-gradient(
                circle,
                rgba(216, 190, 246, 0.85) 0%,
                rgba(186, 146, 226, 0.34) 50%,
                transparent 100%
            );
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(202, 154, 238, 0.55);
            pointer-events: none;
            animation: particleFloat var(--duration) ease-in-out infinite;
            animation-delay: var(--delay);
        }

        @keyframes particleFloat {
            0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1); opacity: 0; }
            20% { opacity: 0.75; }
            50% { transform: translate(var(--drift-x), var(--drift-y)) scale(1.5); opacity: 0.3; }
            80% { opacity: 0.65; }
        }

.sheen-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            border: 1px solid transparent;
            border-radius: inherit;
            background: linear-gradient(
                135deg,
                transparent 0%,
                rgba(200, 160, 240, 0.15) 20%,
                rgba(220, 180, 250, 0.06) 40%,
                rgba(160, 100, 220, 0.12) 60%,
                transparent 80%
            ) border-box;
            -webkit-mask:
                linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) padding-box,
                linear-gradient(#fff 0 0);
            -webkit-mask-composite: xor;
            mask-composite: exclude;
            animation: edgeShimmer 4s ease-in-out infinite;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 4;
        }

        @keyframes edgeShimmer {
            0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; }
            50% { opacity: 0.7; }
        }

.w {
            width: 100%;
            margin: 0;
            padding: 12px 16px;
            background: var(--shell-bg);
            border-top: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--shell-border);
            box-shadow: var(--shell-shadow);
            position: relative;
            overflow: visible;
            /* [perf] 原为 backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(160%) contrast(1.06) brightness(1.04)，
               在 SillyTavern 里 .w 位于父文档中，滚动/流式输出时每帧都要重新采样模糊背景，是最大卡顿源。
               改为不透明的静态渐变：视觉几乎一致，零重采样开销。 */
            background-color: #150a20;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            outline: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
            outline-offset: -2px;
        }

.tb {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
            padding-bottom: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--toolbar-border);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 3;
        }

        .tb-l {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 4px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 5;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .tg {
            width: 24px;
            height: 24px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            border: 1px solid var(--btn-border);
            background: var(--btn-bg);
            box-shadow: 0 2px 7px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
            color: var(--btn-text);
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all var(--transition-smooth);
            font-size: 0.68rem;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .tg:hover {
            border-color: var(--btn-on-border);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.46), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
        }

        .tg.on {
            color: #fff;
            background: var(--btn-on-bg);
            border-color: var(--btn-on-border);
            box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.44), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14), 0 0 0 3px var(--c-soft);
        }

        .tg:active {
            transform: scale(0.93);
            transition: all 0.1s ease;
        }

.ripple-container {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: inherit;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .ripple-effect {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
            transform: scale(0);
            animation: ripple 0.7s ease-out forwards;
            pointer-events: none;
        }

        @keyframes ripple {
            to {
                transform: scale(4);
                opacity: 0;
            }
        }

.tit {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 4px;
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            font: 600 0.85rem "Noto Serif SC", serif;
            color: var(--c);
            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        }

        .tit .heart {
            color: var(--c);
            display: inline-block;
        }

        .ind {
            min-width: 36px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            font-size: 0.62rem;
            color: var(--dim);
            font-weight: 500;
            letter-spacing: 0.03em;
        }

.scene-bar {
            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            gap: 6px 16px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            padding: 7px 12px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            background: var(--panel-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--panel-border);
            box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
            opacity: 0;
            transform: translateY(12px);
            animation: cardSlideUp 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) forwards;
        }

        .scene-chip {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 6px;
            font-size: 0.76rem;
            font-weight: 600;
            letter-spacing: 0.05em;
            color: var(--txt2);
            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
        }

        .scene-chip i {
            font-size: 0.72rem;
            color: var(--c);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--c-glow);
        }

.deck-wrap {
            overflow: hidden;
            padding-bottom: 4px;
            position: relative;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .all-stack {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 12px;
            transition: transform 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
            /* [perf] 原为 will-change: transform —— 每条消息常驻一个合成层，
               长聊天里几十上百层会吃满 GPU 内存并放大滚动重绘。 */
            contain: layout paint style;
        }

.det-r,
        .blk,
        .st-img-c,
        .st-tabs,
        .st-ctrl-bar,
        .close-x,
        .st-btn-s,
        .pv-b,
        #pv,
        #st-m {
            /* [perf] 原本 .pv-b/#pv/#st-m 还各自带 blur(16~28px)；
               弹层背景本身已是不透明渐变，去掉模糊视觉上几乎没有差别。 */
            backdrop-filter: none !important;
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
        }

        .det-r {
            display: flex;
            gap: 12px;
            min-height: 160px;
            padding: 14px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            background: var(--card-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--card-border);
            box-shadow: var(--card-shadow), inset 0 2px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.02), inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: all var(--transition-smooth);
        }

        .det-r:hover {
            background: var(--card-bg-hover);
            border-color: var(--card-border-hover);
            box-shadow: var(--card-shadow-hover);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

.det-r::before {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            opacity: 0.06;
            background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 256 256' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='gn'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='1.2' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23gn)' opacity='0.5'/%3E%3C/svg%3E");
            background-repeat: repeat;
            background-size: 200px 200px;
            /* [perf] 原为 mix-blend-mode: multiply（同上）。 */
            border-radius: inherit;
        }

.av-wrap {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            z-index: 1;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55));
        }

        .av-img {
            width: calc(100px * var(--img-scale));
            height: calc(135px * var(--img-scale));
            border: 3px solid var(--c);
            border-radius: var(--radius-xl);
            object-fit: cover;
            object-position: center top;
            display: block;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
            opacity: 1;
            transition: border-color var(--transition-smooth), box-shadow var(--transition-smooth);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03);
        }

        .av-img:hover {
            box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 0 2px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        }

.inf {
            flex: 1;
            min-width: 0;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 6px;
            z-index: 1;
        }

        .nm-d {
            font: 700 1.3rem "Noto Serif SC", serif;
            color: var(--card-accent, var(--c));
            margin-bottom: 3px;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8);
            letter-spacing: 0.06em;
        }

.blk {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 3px;
            padding: 7px 10px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
            background: var(--block-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--block-border);
            box-shadow: var(--block-shadow);
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            transition: all var(--transition-smooth);
        }

        .blk:hover {
            border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }

        .bt {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 5px;
            font-size: 0.56rem;
            font-weight: 700;
            color: var(--dim);
            opacity: 0.85;
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .bt::before {
            content: "";
            width: 4px;
            height: 4px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: var(--tc, var(--c));
        }

        .bx {
            font-size: calc(0.85rem * var(--text-scale));
            color: var(--txt2);
            font-weight: 500;
            line-height: 1.5;
            white-space: normal;
            word-break: break-word;
            max-height: 160px;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding-right: 3px;
            text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85);
        }

.empty-state,
        .manage-empty {
            padding: 28px 18px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            background: var(--empty-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--empty-border);
            color: var(--empty-text);
            text-align: center;
            line-height: 2;
            font-size: 0.85rem;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

.pv {
            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;
            display: none;
            place-items: center;
            background: var(--overlay-bg);
            z-index: 99;
            padding: 0;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
        }

        .pv-b {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            max-width: 90vw;
            max-height: 90vh;
            border-radius: var(--radius-2xl);
            background: var(--modal-bg);
            border: 1px solid var(--modal-border);
            box-shadow: 0 32px 96px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
            animation: popIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
            backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(130%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(130%);
        }

        .pv-i-c {
            flex: 1;
            padding: 0;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
        }

        .pv-img {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: 84vh;
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
            object-fit: contain;
            transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1), opacity 0.3s ease;
            display: block;
        }

#pv {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            display: none;
            place-items: center;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.82);
            backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%);
            z-index: 30;
            padding: 8px;
            animation: fadeIn 0.2s ease-out;
            border-radius: 2px;
        }

        #pv .pv-b {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            position: relative;
            overflow: hidden;
            background: transparent;
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: 100%;
            box-shadow: none;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
        }

        #pv .pv-i-c {
            flex: 1;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            background: transparent;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        #pv .pv-img {
            max-width: 100%;
            max-height: 100%;
            width: auto;
            height: auto;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);
            box-shadow: 0 14px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01);
            cursor: zoom-out;
            object-fit: contain;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }

#st-m {
            z-index: 150;
            padding: 0;
            place-items: stretch;
            background: var(--overlay-bg);
            backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(130%);
            -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(130%);
        }

        #st-m .pv-b {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            max-width: none;
            max-height: none;

                writeObject(MANUAL_SEL_KEY, manualSel); writeObject(AUTO_SEL_KEY, autoSel);
            }

            function updateAutoImg(name, renew) {
                var list = getImgList(name);
                if (!list.length) { delete autoSel[name]; writeObject(AUTO_SEL_KEY, autoSel); return makeFallbackPortrait(name, DEFAULT_ACCENT); }
                if (renew || !autoSel[name] || !isUrlInList(list, autoSel[name])) { autoSel[name] = pickRandomUrl(list); writeObject(AUTO_SEL_KEY, autoSel); }
                return autoSel[name];
            }

            function getAutoImg(name) { return updateAutoImg(name, false); }
            function resetAutoImg(name) { return updateAutoImg(name, true); }

            function getPreferredImage(name) {
                var list = getImgList(name);
                if (manualSel[name] && isUrlInList(list, manualSel[name])) { return manualSel[name]; }
                return getAutoImg(name);
            }

            function getMessageData() {
                var chatMessages = getChatMessages(getCurrentMessageId());
                if (!chatMessages || !chatMessages.length) { return ''; }
                return chatMessages[0].message || '';
            }

            function parseStatusBlock(statusText, seenMap) {
                var result = []; var blocks = String(statusText || '').split('■'); var i;
                for (i = 0; i < blocks.length; i += 1) {
                    var block = normalizeText(blocks[i]); var nameMatch; var outerMatch; var innerMatch; var name; var outer; var inner;
                    if (!block) { continue; }
                    nameMatch = block.match(/^\s*(?:[*_#]*\s*姓名\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]\s*)?([^\n]+?)(?=\s*[*_#]*\s*(?:外表|内心|时间|地点)\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]|$)/);
                    outerMatch = block.match(/[*_#]*\s*外表\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]\s*([\s\S]+?)(?=\s*[*_#]*\s*(?:内心|时间|地点|姓名)\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]|$)/);
                    innerMatch = block.match(/[*_#]*\s*内心\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]\s*([\s\S]+?)(?=\s*[*_#]*\s*(?:时间|地点|外表|姓名)\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]|$)/);
                    name = cleanField(nameMatch && nameMatch[1] ? nameMatch[1] : '').replace(/[：:]\s*$/, '');
                    outer = cleanField(outerMatch && outerMatch[1] ? outerMatch[1] : '');
                    inner = cleanField(innerMatch && innerMatch[1] ? innerMatch[1] : '');
                    if (!name || CHAR_ORDER.indexOf(name) === -1) { continue; }
                    if (!outer || !inner || seenMap[name]) { continue; }
                    seenMap[name] = true;
                    result.push({ name: name, outer: outer, inner: inner });
                }
                return result;
            }

            function cleanField(text) {
                return normalizeText(text).replace(/^[*_\s]+/, '').replace(/[*_\s]+$/, '');
            }

            function parseSceneMeta(statusText) {
                var text = String(statusText || '');
                var timeMatch = text.match(/[*_#]*\s*时间\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]\s*([^\n■]+)/);
                var placeMatch = text.match(/[*_#]*\s*地点\s*[*_#]*\s*[:：]\s*([^\n■]+)/);
                return {
                    time: cleanField(timeMatch && timeMatch[1] ? timeMatch[1] : ''),
                    place: cleanField(placeMatch && placeMatch[1] ? placeMatch[1] : '')
                };
            }

            function extractSceneData(messageText) {
                var result = [];
                var regex = new RegExp(STATUS_BLOCK_REGEX.source, 'gi');
                var seenMap = {};
                var match = regex.exec(messageText || '');
                var parsed; var i; var meta; var lastBlock = '';

                sceneTime = ''; scenePlace = '';
                while (match !== null) {
                    lastBlock = match[1] || '';
                    match = regex.exec(messageText || '');
                }

                if (lastBlock) {
                    meta = parseSceneMeta(lastBlock);
                    sceneTime = meta.time || '';
                    scenePlace = meta.place || '';
                    result = parseStatusBlock(lastBlock, seenMap);
                } else if ((messageText || '').indexOf('■') !== -1) {
                    meta = parseSceneMeta(messageText || '');
                    sceneTime = meta.time || '';
                    scenePlace = meta.place || '';
                    result = parseStatusBlock(messageText || '', seenMap);
                }

                return result;
            }
            function buildSceneItems(messageText) {
                var parsed = extractSceneData(messageText); var result = []; var i; var name; var list; var image;
                for (i = 0; i < parsed.length; i += 1) {
                    name = parsed[i].name; list = getImgList(name);
                    if (manualSel[name] && isUrlInList(list, manualSel[name])) {
                        image = manualSel[name];
                    } else if (autoSel[name] && isUrlInList(list, autoSel[name])) {
                        image = autoSel[name];
                    } else {
                        image = list[0] && list[0].u ? list[0].u : '';
                        if (image) { autoSel[name] = image; writeObject(AUTO_SEL_KEY, autoSel); }
                    }
                    result.push({ name: name, outer: parsed[i].outer, inner: parsed[i].inner, image: image });
                }
                return result;
            }

            function getSignature(items) { var parts = [sceneTime, scenePlace]; var i; for (i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) { parts.push(items[i].name + '\u241f' + items[i].outer + '\u241f' + items[i].inner); } return parts.join('\u241e'); }
            function getVisibleCount() { return clamp(uiPrefs.visibleCount, 1, 6); }

            function snapStart(index) {
                var size; var safeIndex;
                if (!sceneItems.length) { return 0; }
                size = getVisibleCount(); safeIndex = clamp(index, 0, sceneItems.length - 1);
                return Math.floor(safeIndex / size) * size;
            }

            function findSceneIndexByName(name) { var i; for (i = 0; i < sceneItems.length; i += 1) { if (sceneItems[i].name === name) { return i; } } return -1; }
            function getManagerName(index) { return CHAR_ORDER[clamp(index, 0, Math.max(CHAR_ORDER.length - 1, 0))] || ''; }

            function applyUiPrefs() {
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--img-scale', (uiPrefs.imgSize / 50).toFixed(2));
                document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--text-scale', (uiPrefs.textSize / 100).toFixed(2));
            }

            function renderBlock(title, text, delay) {
                return '' +
                    '<div class="blk anim" style="animation-delay:' + delay + 's">' +
                        '<div class="bt">' + escapeHtml(title) + '</div>' +
                        '<div class="bx">' + formatText(text) + '</div>' +
                    '</div>';
            }

            function renderCard(item, idx, delayBase) {
                return '' +
                    '<div class="det-r anim" style="animation-delay:' + delayBase + 's">' +
                        '<div class="av-wrap" data-av-idx="' + idx + '">' +
                            '<img class="av-img" src="' + escapeHtml(item.image) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(item.name) + '" referrerpolicy="no-referrer">' +
                        '</div>' +
                        '<div class="inf">' +
                            '<div class="nm-d anim" style="animation-delay:' + delayBase + 's">' + escapeHtml(item.name) + '</div>' +
                            renderBlock('外表', item.outer, delayBase + 0.05) +
                            renderBlock('内心', item.inner, delayBase + 0.1) +
                        '</div>' +
                    '</div>';
            }

            function renderDeck() {
                var deck = byId('deck'); var indicator = byId('page-indicator'); var pageSize; var totalPages; var currentPage; var items; var html = ''; var i; var cards; var reuse; var nm;
                if (!sceneItems.length) {
                    if (lastDeckHtml !== '') { lastDeckHtml = ''; deck.innerHTML = '<div class="empty-state">呜哇，现在有点晕嘞~</div>'; }
                    currentStart = 0; indicator.textContent = '0/0'; renderSceneMeta(); return;
                }
                pageSize = getVisibleCount(); currentStart = snapStart(currentStart);
                totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(sceneItems.length / pageSize));
                currentPage = Math.floor(currentStart / pageSize) + 1;
                items = sceneItems.slice(currentStart, currentStart + pageSize);
                indicator.textContent = currentPage + '/' + totalPages;
                cards = deck.querySelectorAll('.det-r');
                reuse = (cards.length === items.length);
                if (reuse) {
                    for (i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) {
                        nm = cards[i].querySelector('.nm-d');
                        if (!nm || nm.textContent !== items[i].name) { reuse = false; break; }
                    }
                }
                if (reuse) {
                    for (i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) { updateCardNode(cards[i], items[i]); }
                } else {
                    for (i = 0; i < items.length; i += 1) { html += renderCard(items[i], currentStart + i, i * 0.04); }
                    lastDeckHtml = html;
                    deck.innerHTML = html;
                    deck.classList.add('deck-ready');
                }
                renderSceneMeta();
            }

            function updateCardNode(cardEl, item) {
                var nm = cardEl.querySelector('.nm-d');
                var bxs = cardEl.querySelectorAll('.blk .bx');
                var img = cardEl.querySelector('.av-img');
                if (nm && nm.textContent !== item.name) { nm.textContent = item.name; }
                if (bxs.length > 0 && bxs[0].textContent !== item.outer) { bxs[0].textContent = item.outer; }
                if (bxs.length > 1 && bxs[1].textContent !== item.inner) { bxs[1].textContent = item.inner; }
                if (img && img.getAttribute('src') !== item.image) { img.setAttribute('src', item.image); }
            }

            function renderSceneMeta() {
                var bar = byId('scene-bar'); var html = '';
                if (!sceneItems.length) {
                    if (lastMetaHtml !== '') { lastMetaHtml = ''; bar.innerHTML = ''; }
                    bar.style.display = 'none'; return;
                }
                if (sceneTime) { html += '<span class="scene-chip"><i class="fa-regular fa-clock" aria-hidden="true"></i>' + escapeHtml(sceneTime) + '</span>'; }
                if (scenePlace) { html += '<span class="scene-chip"><i class="fa-solid fa-location-dot" aria-hidden="true"></i>' + escapeHtml(scenePlace) + '</span>'; }
                if (html !== lastMetaHtml) { lastMetaHtml = html; bar.innerHTML = html; }
                bar.style.display = html ? 'flex' : 'none';
            }

            function openPreview(index) { if (!sceneItems[index]) { return; } previewIndex = index; setShown('pv', true); renderPreview(); }
            function closePreview() { previewIndex = -1; setShown('pv', false); }

            function renderPreview() {
                var item; var img;
                if (previewIndex < 0 || !sceneItems[previewIndex]) { closePreview(); return; }
                item = sceneItems[previewIndex];
                img = byId('pvi'); img.style.opacity = '0';
                img.onload = function () { img.style.opacity = '1'; };
                img.alt = item.name;
                img.src = item.image;
            }

            function changePreview(delta) { if (!sceneItems.length || previewIndex < 0) { return; } previewIndex = (previewIndex + delta + sceneItems.length) % sceneItems.length; renderPreview(); }

            function changePage(delta) {
                var pageSize; var totalPages; var currentPage;
                if (!sceneItems.length) { return; }
                pageSize = getVisibleCount(); totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(sceneItems.length / pageSize));
                currentPage = Math.floor(snapStart(currentStart) / pageSize);
                currentPage = (currentPage + delta + totalPages) % totalPages;
                currentStart = currentPage * pageSize; renderDeck();
            }

            function syncSceneImageByName(name, url) {
                var i;
                for (i = 0; i < sceneItems.length; i += 1) { if (sceneItems[i].name === name) { sceneItems[i].image = url; } }
                if (previewIndex >= 0 && sceneItems[previewIndex] && sceneItems[previewIndex].name === name && isShown('pv')) { renderPreview(); }
            }

            function openManager() {
                var anchorName = sceneItems[currentStart] ? sceneItems[currentStart].name : getManagerName(managerIndex);
                var idx = CHAR_ORDER.indexOf(anchorName);
                if (idx >= 0) { managerIndex = idx; }
                setShown('st-m', true); renderManager();
            }

            function closeManager() { setShown('st-m', false); }

            function renderManagerTabs() {
                var html = ''; var i; var name;
                for (i = 0; i < CHAR_ORDER.length; i += 1) { name = CHAR_ORDER[i]; html += '<button type="button" class="st-tab' + (i === managerIndex ? ' on' : '') + '" data-tab-index="' + i + '">' + escapeHtml(name) + '</button>'; }
                if (html !== lastTabsHtml) { lastTabsHtml = html; byId('st-tabs').innerHTML = html; }
            }

            function renderManagerGrid() {
                var name = getManagerName(managerIndex); var list = getImgList(name); var currentUrl = getPreferredImage(name);
                var stat = byId('st-stat'); var grid = byId('st-grid'); var resetBtn = byId('st-reset');
                var accent = DEFAULT_ACCENT; var safeName = escapeHtml(name); var html = ''; var i; var itemUrl;
                if (!name) { stat.textContent = '当前：无可管理角色'; grid.innerHTML = '<div class="manage-empty">当前没有可管理角色。</div>'; resetBtn.disabled = true; return; }
                if (!list.length) { stat.innerHTML = '当前：<span style="color:' + accent + '">' + safeName + '</span> 暂无立绘可管理'; grid.innerHTML = '<div class="manage-empty">' + safeName + ' 的立绘尚未配置，后续将图片网址填入 IMG_DATA 即可启用。</div>'; resetBtn.disabled = true; return; }
                stat.innerHTML = '当前：<span style="color:' + accent + '">' + safeName + '</span>';
                for (i = 0; i < list.length; i += 1) {
                    itemUrl = list[i].u;
                    html += '' +
                        '<button type="button" class="st-img-c' + (currentUrl === itemUrl ? ' sel' : '') + '" data-img-index="' + i + '">' +
                            '<img class="st-img" src="' + escapeHtml(itemUrl) + '" referrerpolicy="no-referrer" alt="' + safeName + '">' +
                            (currentUrl === itemUrl ? '<span class="st-chk"><i class="fa-solid fa-check" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>' : '') +
                        '</button>';
                }
                if (html !== lastGridHtml) { lastGridHtml = html; grid.innerHTML = html; }
                resetBtn.disabled = false;
            }

            function renderManager() { renderManagerTabs(); renderManagerGrid(); }

            function selectManagedImage(index) {
                var name = getManagerName(managerIndex); var list = getImgList(name); var url;
                if (!name || !list[index] || !list[index].u) { return; }
                url = list[index].u;
                manualSel[name] = url; writeObject(MANUAL_SEL_KEY, manualSel);
                syncSceneImageByName(name, url); renderDeck(); renderManager();
            }

            function resetManagedImage() {
                var name = getManagerName(managerIndex); var list; var url;
                if (!name) { return; }
                list = getImgList(name);
                if (!list.length) { return; }
                delete manualSel[name]; writeObject(MANUAL_SEL_KEY, manualSel);
                url = pickRandomUrl(list); autoSel[name] = url; writeObject(AUTO_SEL_KEY, autoSel);
                syncSceneImageByName(name, url); renderDeck(); renderManager();
            }

            function refreshScene(force) {
                var anchorName = sceneItems[currentStart] ? sceneItems[currentStart].name : '';
                var previewName = previewIndex >= 0 && sceneItems[previewIndex] ? sceneItems[previewIndex].name : '';
                if (force) { var k; for (k = 0; k < CHAR_ORDER.length; k += 1) { resetAutoImg(CHAR_ORDER[k]); } }
                var messageText = getMessageData(); var nextItems = buildSceneItems(messageText); var nextSignature = getSignature(nextItems);
                var anchorIdx; var previewIdx;
                if (!force && nextSignature === lastSignature) { return; }
                lastSignature = nextSignature; sceneItems = nextItems;
                if (anchorName) { anchorIdx = findSceneIndexByName(anchorName); currentStart = anchorIdx >= 0 ? snapStart(anchorIdx) : 0; }
                else { currentStart = 0; }
                renderDeck();
                if (previewName) { previewIdx = findSceneIndexByName(previewName); if (previewIdx >= 0) { previewIndex = previewIdx; renderPreview(); } else { closePreview(); } }
                if (isShown('st-m')) { renderManager(); }
            }

            function bindSwipeArea(area, targetId, onCommit) {
                var startX = null; var startY = 0; var currentX = 0; var moving = false;
                function getPoint(event) { if (event.touches && event.touches.length) { return event.touches[0]; } if (event.changedTouches && event.changedTouches.length) { return event.changedTouches[0]; } return event; }
                function getTarget() { return byId(targetId); }
                function start(event) { var point = getPoint(event); var target = getTarget(); startX = point.clientX; startY = point.clientY; currentX = startX; moving = false; if (target) { target.style.transition = 'none'; } }
                function move(event) { var point; var dx; var dy; var target; if (startX === null) { return; } point = getPoint(event); dx = point.clientX - startX; dy = point.clientY - startY; target = getTarget(); if (!moving) { moving = Math.abs(dx) > Math.abs(dy) && Math.abs(dx) > 10; } if (!moving) { return; } if (event.cancelable) { event.preventDefault(); } currentX = point.clientX; if (target) { target.style.transform = 'translateX(' + (dx * 0.32) + 'px)'; } }
                function end() { var target = getTarget(); var dx; if (startX === null) { return; } dx = currentX - startX; if (moving && Math.abs(dx) > Math.max(46, area.offsetWidth * 0.14)) { onCommit(dx < 0 ? 1 : -1); } if (target) { target.style.transition = 'transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)'; target.style.transform = 'translateX(0)'; } startX = null; currentX = 0; moving = false; }
                area.addEventListener('touchstart', start); area.addEventListener('touchmove', move, { passive: false }); area.addEventListener('touchend', end);
                area.addEventListener('mousedown', start); document.addEventListener('mousemove', move); document.addEventListener('mouseup', end);
            }

            function bindCardLongPress() {
                var deck = byId('deck'); var longPressTimer = null; var movedInGesture = false;
                var gestureActive = false; var startX = 0; var startY = 0; var activeIdx = -1;
                var LONG_PRESS_MS = 500; var MOVE_THRESHOLD = 8;

                function clearTimer() { if (longPressTimer) { clearTimeout(longPressTimer); longPressTimer = null; } }
                function resetGestureState() { movedInGesture = false; gestureActive = false; activeIdx = -1; startX = 0; startY = 0; clearTimer(); }

                function startGesture(event) {
                    var node = findDataNode(event.target, 'data-av-idx', null);
                    if (!node) { resetGestureState(); return; }
                    var point = (event.touches && event.touches[0]) || event;
                    gestureActive = true; activeIdx = Number(node.getAttribute('data-av-idx'));
                    startX = point.clientX; startY = point.clientY;
                    movedInGesture = false; clearTimer();
                    longPressTimer = setTimeout(function () { if (sceneItems[activeIdx]) { openPreview(activeIdx); } resetGestureState(); }, LONG_PRESS_MS);
                }

                function duringGesture(event) {
                    if (!gestureActive) { return; }
                    var point = (event.touches && event.touches[0]) || event;
                    var dx = point.clientX - startX; var dy = point.clientY - startY;
                    if (Math.abs(dx) > MOVE_THRESHOLD || Math.abs(dy) > MOVE_THRESHOLD) { movedInGesture = true; clearTimer(); }
                }

                function endGesture() { if (!gestureActive) { return; } clearTimer(); resetGestureState(); }

                deck.addEventListener('touchstart', startGesture, { passive: true }); deck.addEventListener('touchmove', duringGesture, { passive: true }); deck.addEventListener('touchend', endGesture);
                deck.addEventListener('mousedown', startGesture); document.addEventListener('mousemove', duringGesture); document.addEventListener('mouseup', endGesture);
            }

            function createRipple(event, el) {
                var ripple = document.createElement('span');
                var rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
                var size = Math.max(rect.width, rect.height);
                var x = (event.clientX || (event.touches && event.touches[0] && event.touches[0].clientX) || rect.left + rect.width / 2) - rect.left - size / 2;
                var y = (event.clientY || (event.touches && event.touches[0] && event.touches[0].clientY) || rect.top + rect.height / 2) - rect.top - size / 2;
                ripple.className = 'ripple-effect';
                ripple.style.width = size + 'px';
                ripple.style.height = size + 'px';
                ripple.style.left = x + 'px';
                ripple.style.top = y + 'px';
                var container = el.querySelector('.ripple-container');
                if (!container) { container = document.createElement('span'); container.className = 'ripple-container'; el.style.position = el.style.position || 'relative'; el.appendChild(container); }
                container.appendChild(ripple);
                ripple.addEventListener('animationend', function () { ripple.remove(); });
            }

            function attachRippleToButtons() {
                document.addEventListener('click', function (event) {
                    var target = event.target;
                    while (target && target !== document.body) {
                        if (target.matches && (target.matches('.tg') || target.matches('.st-btn-s') || target.matches('.close-x') || target.matches('.st-tab'))) {
                            createRipple(event, target);
                            return;
                        }
                        target = target.parentNode;
                    }
                });
            }

            function bindEvents() {
                byId('lk').onclick = function (event) { stopEvent(event); openManager(); };

                bindCardLongPress();
                bindDelegatedClick('st-tabs', 'data-tab-index', function (idx) { managerIndex = idx; renderManager(); });
                bindDelegatedClick('st-grid', 'data-img-index', selectManagedImage);

                bindOverlay('pv', 'pvb', closePreview);
                byId('pvb').onclick = closePreview;
                bindOverlay('st-m', 'st-box', closeManager);
                byId('st-close').onclick = closeManager;
                byId('st-reset').onclick = resetManagedImage;

                /* [perf] 原为 document.onkeydown = ...，会直接覆盖宿主（SillyTavern 或其它
                   正则）已经挂在同一个 document 上的 onkeydown，属于会打架的写法；
                   改成 addEventListener，并让普通字符在进入 indexOf 链之前就返回。 */
                document.addEventListener('keydown', function (event) {
                    var key = event.key || '';
                    if (isShown('pv')) { if (key.indexOf('Left') !== -1) { changePreview(-1); } if (key.indexOf('Right') !== -1) { changePreview(1); } if (key === 'Escape') { closePreview(); } return; }
                    if (isShown('st-m')) { if (key === 'Escape') { closeManager(); } return; }
                    if (key.length === 1) { return; }
                    if (key.indexOf('Left') !== -1) { changePage(-1); }
                    if (key.indexOf('Right') !== -1) { changePage(1); }
                });

                bindSwipeArea(byId('deck-wrap'), 'deck', changePage);
                bindSwipeArea(byId('pvic'), 'pvi', changePreview);
                attachRippleToButtons();

            }

            function createParticles(container, count) {
                var fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
                var i, particle, size;
                if (!container) { return; }
                for (i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
                    particle = document.createElement('div');
                    particle.className = 'particle';
                    size = (Math.random() * 2 + 1).toFixed(1);
                    particle.style.width = size + 'px';
                    particle.style.height = size + 'px';
                    particle.style.top = (Math.random() * 100) + '%';
                    particle.style.left = (Math.random() * 100) + '%';
                    particle.style.setProperty('--drift-x', (Math.random() * 30 - 15) + 'px');
                    particle.style.setProperty('--drift-y', (Math.random() * 25 - 12) + 'px');
                    particle.style.setProperty('--duration', (Math.random() * 6 + 5) + 's');
                    particle.style.setProperty('--delay', (Math.random() * 8) + 's');
                    fragment.appendChild(particle);
                }
                container.appendChild(fragment);
            }

            function init() {
                loadStoredState();
                applyUiPrefs();
                bindEvents();
                createParticles(byId('stars-layer'), window.innerWidth <= 760 ? 10 : 30);
                refreshScene(true);
                /* [perf] 原为同步 precacheAllImages()：桌面端每帧一次性插入 52 个
                   <link rel=prefetch as=image>，长聊天里就是成百上千个预取请求堆在首帧。
                   改到空闲回调里再做，首帧只负责把状态栏画出来。 */
                scheduleIdle(function () { precacheAllImages(); });

                window.setInterval(function () { refreshScene(false); }, 700);
            }

            function onReady(fn) {
                if (typeof window.jQuery === 'function') { window.jQuery(fn); return; }
                if (typeof window.$ === 'function') { try { window.$(fn); return; } catch (error) {} }
                fn();
            }

            window.refreshStatusBar = function () { refreshScene(true); };
            onReady(init);
        })();
    </script>
